honing_confound: Hunger Reaper's Chaos Mode amplification (+28% Attack Power, +23% Crit Rate per search sources) compounds with Specialization (gear honing). Specialization directly scales the Red skill (Chaos Mode) damage output. At T4, the Chaos Mode sustained buff applied over the full 15-second duration with fast-refresh via Dagger/Shadow hits creates a continuous compounding advantage.

delivery.evidence: Reaper is a close-range melee assassin using three skill color categories: Shadow Skills (Green — primary meter builders), Dagger Skills (Purple — gap closers + secondary meter), Swoop Skills (Red — Chaos Mode burst damage). Hunger uses Dagger + Shadow hits to fuel and sustain Chaos Mode; Persona (Z) explicitly NOT used in Hunger.

footprint.evidence: Melee dagger/shadow attacks: small arc footprints and narrow-burst AoEs. No wide-zone identity.

geo_text: Hunger Reaper fills Red Chaos gauge via Dagger Skill hits and Shadow Skill use → Red gauge full → Chaos Mode (15 seconds): +23% Crit Rate, +28% Attack Power, +10% Attack Speed, +10% Move Speed. Chaos Mode refreshes with each Dagger/Shadow skill hit — maintaining constant hits extends Chaos Mode indefinitely in practice. HUNGER IDENTITY: does NOT use Persona (Z); instead, Hunger increases Chaos gauge generation rate and amplifies Chaos Mode buffs. Identity is maintaining Chaos Mode through continuous high-APM Dagger + Shadow skill cycling.

control.evidence: Some Reaper skills have knockdown on impact. No CC-centered identity.

defense.evidence: Low armor (leather-class). Good mobility. Back-attack requirement demands active repositioning.

economy.plain_text: CHAOS MAINTENANCE ECONOMY: Dagger + Shadow skills fill Red Chaos Gauge → Chaos Mode activates (15s decay, refreshed per Dagger/Shadow hit) → stay in Chaos Mode as long as possible by continuous skill use. HUNGER IDENTITY: increased Chaos gauge generation + amplified Chaos Mode buffs (+23% Crit Rate, +28% Attack Power vs base values). Persona (Z) is explicitly NOT used. Economy: high-APM continuous skill cycling to prevent Chaos Mode from expiring.

element.evidence: Reaper uses shadow-infused dagger attacks. Physical damage with Dark elemental flavor.

movement.evidence: Good mobility. Multiple Reaper skills have dash components. Chaos Mode: +10% Move Speed. Back-attack positioning requires active repositioning.

range.evidence: Dagger skills: 0-5m melee. Shadow skills can reach up to ~8m. No long-range capability.

tempo.evidence: Hunger is sustained: continuous Chaos Mode maintenance via constant skill cycling. No discrete burst spike — the identity is maintaining the enhancement buff permanently through high APM.

amp.value: Chaos Mode: +23% Crit Rate, +28% Attack Power, +10% Attack Speed, +10% Move Speed; Hunger identity amplifies Chaos gauge generation and Mode buff values
amp.evidence: Search results: 'Hunger grants increased Chaos gauge generation and +25% Attack Power when full.' Maxroll: '+23% Crit Rate, +28% Attack Power, +10% Attack Speed.' Values are Hunger-amplified Chaos Mode numbers — base class Chaos Mode is lower.

commitment.evidence: Hunger playstyle is high-APM instant-cast skill cycling. Dagger and Shadow skills are fast-animation attacks designed for rapid continuous use.

mechanics_notes: 1) PERSONA (Z) IS NOT USED in Hunger: this is an explicit identity constraint — the Hunger engraving focuses on Chaos Mode instead of Persona Mode. The Reaper has two identity mechanics (Persona via Green gauge, Chaos Mode via Red gauge) and Hunger actively deprioritizes one entire identity system. 2) CHAOS MODE REFRESH MECHANIC: each Dagger/Shadow skill hit refreshes the 15-second Chaos Mode timer. Skilled play means Chaos Mode never actually expires — it operates as a permanent buff in well-executed rotations. 3) HIGH APM DEMAND: Hunger Reaper is among LA's highest APM requirements — constant skill cycling to sustain Chaos Mode creates one of the most input-intensive identities. Noted as 'High APM' in Maxroll guide. 4) Hunger vs Lunar Voice fork: Hunger = sustain Chaos Mode permanently through APM; Lunar Voice = build Persona, activate for +170% Swoop burst, use Shadow Blade to amplify. Both B-tier (Maxroll Aug 2025) but different skill expression.
stabilization_patch: Hunger has oscillated with Lunar Voice in meta preference; both consistently middle-tier.

Positional requirement (back-attack for Swoop Skills in Persona) compounds with Crit Rate gear to create multi-axis confound.

Shadow/Dagger skills build Persona Meter. Back-attack positioning required for maximum Swoop output.

footprint.evidence: Swoop Skills: melee-range targeted attacks with arc or point footprints. Dagger/Shadow builder skills: similar small footprint.

geo_text: Lunar Voice Reaper fills Green Persona Meter via Shadow Skills and Dagger Skills → Persona (Z): 10 seconds of stealth with controllable clone (+170% damage to Swoop Skills, +Crit Rate, +Move Speed). In Persona Mode: Swoop Skill hits as back-attack generate Dismantle Weak Point stacks; 3 stacks → Shadow Blade effect (large damage amplification on next Swoop). LUNAR VOICE IDENTITY: Persona Mode immediately grants +170% Swoop damage on activation (vs having to stack up — the burst is immediate). Identity: fill meter → activate Persona → maximize Swoop hits within 10s window → Shadow Blade detonation.

control.evidence: Some Swoop Skills have knockdown on impact. No CC-centered identity.

defense.evidence: Persona Mode provides stealth — a repositioning/safety window when Persona is activated. Human form: dodge-based. Stealth is brief and not a sustained defense layer.

In Persona: use Swoop Skills as back-attacks to stack Dismantle Weak Point (3 stacks → Shadow Blade → amplified Swoop burst). Persona ends when Purple gauge depletes or player exits. movement.evidence: High mobility. Persona Mode adds stealth repositioning. Back-attack positioning demands active movement. Lunar Voice described as 'stylish, mobile gameplay' in guide.

tempo.evidence: Lunar Voice is the burst identity: Persona activation → 10s Swoop burst window → Shadow Blade detonation. Meter-fill phase is the build; Persona window is the burst. Opposite of Hunger's sustained approach.

amp.value: Persona Mode: +170% Swoop Skill damage, Crit Rate bonus, Move Speed bonus; Shadow Blade: additional Swoop amplification at 3 Dismantle Weak Point stacks; back-attack: +10% Crit Rate +5% Damage
amp.evidence: Maxroll Lunar Voice guide: 'Persona provides 10 seconds of stealth granting +170% damage to Swoop Skills.' Shadow Blade mechanic from nexus-guide and earlier search.

proxy.evidence: The Persona Mode clone is a visual effect (movable via mouse) — it acts as a visual indicator of the stealth window, not an autonomous damage-dealing entity. Not classified as proxy.

commitment.evidence: Primary Swoop Skills (Rage Spear, Dance of Fury, Finishing Step) have wind-up animations in Persona Mode. The 10s window creates implicit commitment pressure — must use the burst window fully.

mechanics_notes: 1) PERSONA CLONE is NOT a proxy entity: the clone in Persona Mode is a visual/positional indicator that moves with mouse hover. It does not deal independent damage — it is a stealth-movement tool. This is distinct from true proxy delivery (Loyal Companion Silverhawk, Communication Overflow pet army). 2) SHADOW BLADE MECHANIC: Swoop Skills land as back-attacks in Persona Mode → each hit generates Dismantle Weak Point → 3 stacks → Shadow Blade buff → next Swoop Skill deals amplified damage. This creates a 'within the burst window, build to a secondary spike' sub-cycle. 3) BACK-ATTACK POSITIONING IS CRITICAL for Lunar Voice: missing back-attacks in Persona Mode removes the Dismantle Weak Point stacking AND the +10% Crit / +5% Damage bonus. Guide notes 'missing back attacks is heavily punishing.' Highest positional demand of all Reaper builds. 4) Lunar Voice vs Hunger fork: Lunar Voice = positional burst expertise (10s Persona window + Shadow Blade); Hunger = APM sustained (no Persona, maintain Chaos Mode forever). Both B-tier — different risk profiles for same mechanical tier.
stabilization_patch: Lunar Voice favored in stationary boss content; Hunger in mobile raids. Both oscillate in preference.
tier_standing_current: B-tier (Maxroll community tier list August 2025). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: +170% Swoop in Persona at T4 Specialization creates significant ceiling — but positional requirement (back-attack) means the honing benefit is gated behind execution quality.
